survey_tie_rule: DHS first, then MICS, then alphabetical survey name
duplicate_rule: Collapse identical values at the measurement key. Exclude an entire country-survey-year if any required wealth quintile or national completion value conflicts.
estimand: Equal-country conditional linear association in the observed complete-case sample. The education coefficient is life-ladder points per 10 percentage-point larger signed Q5-Q1 completion gap.
analysis_scope: Independent empirical study of socioeconomic completion gaps and national life evaluation
panel_education_rule: Latest valid survey in the disjoint three-year block immediately preceding each non-overlapping three-year happiness window
